title: Find strain-specific islands with comparison rings
summary: Start from the Web defaults for the Escherichia coli O157:H7 Sakai chromosome, add three genomes as nucleotide identity rings with one LOSATN search, name six islands from a region table, and stretch their tints across the rings, generating after each change.
primaryWorkflow: Circular comparison rings with region annotations

downloads.label: NC_002695.2
downloads.note: Download the complete chromosome of Escherichia coli O157:H7 Sakai as a GenBank flat file and save it as NC_002695.2.gbk, the filename stored in the Gallery session.

downloads.label: NZ_CP008957.1
downloads.note: Download the chromosome of E. coli O157:H7 EDL933 as FASTA and save it as NZ_CP008957.1.fna.

downloads.label: NC_000913.3
downloads.note: Download the chromosome of E. coli K-12 MG1655 as FASTA and save it as NC_000913.3.fna.

downloads.label: NC_004431.1
downloads.note: Download the chromosome of the uropathogenic E. coli CFT073 as FASTA and save it as NC_004431.1.fna.

downloads.label: Island table
downloads.note: Six Sakai regions that K-12 and CFT073 largely lack, in two region sets: islands_tint holds one highlight per region, and islands holds one labelled line per region.

manualSteps.title: Switch to Circular mode
manualSteps.body: Open gbdraw.app and check that the Circular drawing is shown before adding the GenBank file.

media.alt: Drawing bar with the Circular drawing tab selected and the + Linear tab beside it.
media.caption: The Circular drawing is shown when the app opens.

manualSteps.title: Upload the GenBank file
manualSteps.body: Upload NC_002695.2.gbk as the Circular GenBank input and set Output Prefix. Leave Species empty: the app reads the organism and strain from the file and draws them in the center.

media.alt: Circular Input Genomes card with NC_002695.2.gbk selected as the GenBank file.
media.caption: Upload NC_002695.2.gbk in the Circular GenBank uploader.

media.alt: Basic card with ecoli_o157_sakai_rings as the output prefix and an empty Species field.
media.caption: Set Output Prefix to ecoli_o157_sakai_rings.

manualSteps.title: Generate with the defaults
manualSteps.body: Click Generate Diagram. The defaults draw the features on two strands with a GC content ring and a GC skew ring, and the legend at the left. The center gives the organism, strain, accession, length, and GC content from the file.

media.alt: E. coli O157:H7 Sakai preview with the Web defaults: features on two strands, GC content and GC skew rings, the legend at the left, and no comparison rings.
media.caption: Web defaults: features, GC content, and GC skew; nothing shows what other strains share.

manualSteps.title: Compare the chromosome with three genomes
manualSteps.body: Open Pairwise Comparisons. Run LOSAT is the default source, and the default LOSAT mode, BLASTN, compares nucleotide sequences. Click Add comparison sequence, choose NZ_CP008957.1.fna, and type O157:H7 EDL933 in the name box beside the ring's color. Click the color box and set #81a5cc: Ring colors is Same color by default, so a ring without a color of its own draws the default color. Add NC_000913.3.fna and NC_004431.1.fna the same way, one at a time, with the names and colors in the table. Show Comparison Rings in Layout turns on with the first file. Click Generate Diagram: LOSATN compares each genome with the chromosome once, and three identity rings appear inside the features, outer to inner in the order you added them. The EDL933 ring is closed except one gap near 5.05 Mbp. The K-12 and CFT073 rings break at the same places, around 0.9, 1.3, 1.4, 2.9, 4.6, and 5.05 Mbp: stretches of the Sakai chromosome that these two strains lack.

replay.script: const labels = ["Pairwise Comparisons", "Layout"]; labels.forEach((label) => { const nodes = [...document.querySelectorAll('summary')].filter((s) => s.getAttribute('aria-label') === label); if (!nodes.length) throw new Error(`Summary ${label} not found.`); nodes.forEach((s) => { if (s.parentElement) s.parentElement.open = true; }); });

media.alt: Comparison sequence files in Pairwise Comparisons: NZ_CP008957.1.fna named O157:H7 EDL933, NC_000913.3.fna named K-12 MG1655, and NC_004431.1.fna named CFT073 (UPEC), each with its own color, and the Add comparison sequence button.
media.caption: Add the three genomes one at a time and name each ring.

manualSteps.title: Name the islands from a region table
manualSteps.body: The gaps have no names yet. Open Region Annotations, click Import TSV, and choose ecoli_o157_sakai_islands.tsv. It adds two region sets: islands_tint, with one highlight per island, and islands, with one labelled line per island. Click Generate Diagram; it reuses the cached LOSAT results. Six labelled lines appear outside the map, and six tints mark the islands on the feature track.

manualSteps.title: Stretch the tints across the rings
manualSteps.body: The tints stop at the feature track, while the gaps they explain are in the rings. In Layout, open Custom Track Slots and turn on Use custom stack. The stack starts with a row for each region set, placed as the figure draws it now: annotations_1 lays islands_tint behind the features, and annotations_2 draws islands outside the Axis. In the annotations_1 row, set Extend to conservation_CFT073_UPEC, the innermost ring, set the layer to Foreground, so that the tints lie over the rings, and set padding to 2. Click Generate Diagram; it reuses the cached LOSAT results. Each tint now runs from the feature track through all three rings, and the gaps of K-12 and CFT073, and the one gap of EDL933 at the Sakai-only prophage, sit inside the named islands.

replay.script: const toggle = document.querySelector('[aria-controls="circular-custom-track-slots-panel"]'); if (!toggle) throw new Error('Custom Track Slots toggle not found.'); let node = toggle; while (node) { if (node.tagName === 'DETAILS' && !node.open) node.open = true; node = node.parentElement; } if (toggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') !== 'true') toggle.click();

media.alt: Top of the custom stack with Use custom stack on: the annotations_2 row with Annotation set islands above the Axis, then the features row below it.
media.caption: Turn on Use custom stack; its annotations_2 row already draws islands outside the Axis.

troubleshooting.title: No comparison rings are drawn
troubleshooting.body: Check that the three comparison files are listed in Pairwise Comparisons with Run LOSAT chosen, and that Show Comparison Rings in Layout is on.

troubleshooting.title: The region tints or labels disappear after Use custom stack is turned on
troubleshooting.body: A custom stack draws only the region sets it has a row for. Add an Annotations row for islands_tint and one for islands, as in the last step.

troubleshooting.title: The island names are drawn in the center of the map
troubleshooting.body: The annotations_2 row is below the Axis. Choose Row actions, Move outside Axis on that row.

troubleshooting.title: The generated diagram differs from the Gallery image
troubleshooting.body: Check the ring order (O157:H7 EDL933, K-12 MG1655, CFT073 (UPEC), outer to inner), the region table ecoli_o157_sakai_islands.tsv, the two Annotations rows, and Extend to conservation_CFT073_UPEC.
